data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2039 is set to be the biggest LGBTQ+ celebration on the Costa del Sol, with parades, beach parties, and live music across Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina. A Marbella Pride yacht charter 2039 from Puerto Banús gives you the best seat in the house: your own private boat, with skipper, drinks, and snacks included. Whether you want to watch the parade from the water, cruise to Cala del Faro for a swim, or host a sunset after-party, our fleet has options for groups of 5 to 12 guests.

Why choose a yacht for Marbella Pride 2039?

Marbella Pride attracts over 50,000 visitors each year. The main parade route runs along the Golden Mile and through Puerto Banús, where streets fill with floats, music, and dancers. From a yacht, you get a panoramic view without the crowds. You can anchor near the marina entrance, watch the parade pass, then join the party on land. After the parade, a sunset cruise to Cala Cortés or Estepona offers a quieter escape. Our boats depart from Puerto Banús – a 5-minute walk from the Pride main stage.

Our Pride-ready fleet from Puerto Banús

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of the Pride celebrations. Choose from:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h. Great for a small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing. Open flybridge for parade views.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski. Ideal for a party.
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m, 12 pax) – same spec, different colour.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – price on request. Spacious saloon and flybridge.
  • K80 (24m, 12 pax) – price on request. Modern design.
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) – price on request. Sporty option.
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – price on request. Classic lines.
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) – price on request. Open cockpit.
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) – price on request. Catamaran stability.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – price on request. Speed and style.
  • Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) – price on request. Compact and fast.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – price on request. Budget-friendly.
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – price on request. Smallest option.
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – price on request. Ideal for couples.
  • Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) – price on request. Luxury flagship.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. For boats not in Tier A or B, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

What's included in every Pride charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper (English/Spanish), fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts), insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is included free for 30 minutes. You can bring your own food, decorations, and music – just no glass bottles on board.

Pride 2039 itinerary ideas

Here are three popular options for a Marbella Pride yacht charter 2039:

  • Parade viewing (2h): Depart Puerto Banús at 16:00, anchor near the marina entrance, watch the parade from the water. Return at 18:00 to join the street party. €749 on Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39.
  • Sunset cruise (2h): Depart at 19:00, cruise to Cala del Faro or Cabopino for a swim, return at 21:00 as the sun sets behind La Concha. €749–€1,199 depending on boat.
  • Full-day party (8h): Depart at 10:00, head to Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch, anchor for swimming, then return for the evening Pride events. €2,299 on Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. Larger boats on request.

How to book your Pride yacht

Booking is simple. Visit our main page and click the WhatsApp button. Tell us your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability within 1 hour. No deposit required – pay on arrival by card or cash. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. For boats with pricing on request, we'll send a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for Pride week, as slots fill quickly.

Why Puerto Banús is the best base for Pride

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of Marbella Pride. The marina hosts the main stage, DJ sets, and drag shows. It's also the departure point for all our yachts. After your cruise, you're steps away from the Golden Mile's bars and restaurants. The water temperature in June averages 22°C, perfect for swimming. The prevailing wind is light (5–10 knots), so sea conditions are calm. For a quieter option, Cabopino beach is 10 minutes by boat and has a nudist section.
